configuration_selection: Representation chosen among 12 full-hybrid variants on these folds (paired bootstrap 95% interval of the change vs the identity control within [-0.002, +0.003]); guards and P correction as in earlier versions; final parsing corrections and datasheet-checked material values not chosen by score

late_layer.note: non-negative least squares on inner-fold deltas, x0.5; text-reading heads not used

scope: Fixed random-row outer five folds on the 6,244-point dataset (6,169 literature points from 429 papers, 75 Polybot runs). Not a wet-lab or control-range extrapolation test.

representation.chemistry: additives and post-treatment chemicals as cheminformatics descriptors (35 RDKit descriptors and functional-group counts, structure classes, dose); grade and substrate as material descriptors; no name identities, no text embedding
representation.dose_and_strength_gates: v0.2.1: additive/post-treatment descriptors weighted by a smooth dose gate (all units converted to vol%), acids by a Hill function of concentration with evaporative concentration for hot-drop protocols, additive signal damped under a strong acid, operation flags read from text, temperatures held at the training support; training jitter of temperatures (+-6 C), durations (+-20%) and doses (+-10%) on the identity-masked copies

unseen_chemistry_grouped_cv_r2_log10.note: representation study of v0.2.0 on the same folds (text-free M), before the v0.2.1 physical-consistency changes

physical_consistency_checks.description: one-factor-at-a-time checks against classic PEDOT:PSS literature (trace doses, acid strength, temperature steps, units, stacking, wording); pass/fail per check
